request.style: English, contemporary worship, male lead vocal with congregation-style backing, electric guitars with delay, piano, synth pad, bass, building drums, earnest and rising, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Here are my hands, the work I do
Here are my days, I give them to you
Not just a song on a Sunday morning
All of my life laid down before you

[Chorus]
By the mercies of God
I offer my body as a living sacrifice
Holy and pleasing to God
This is my spiritual worship

[Verse]
Do not be conformed to this age
But be transformed by the renewing of your mind
So that you can discern what God's will is
What is good and pleasing and perfect

[Chorus]
By the mercies of God
I offer my body as a living sacrifice
Holy and pleasing to God
This is my spiritual worship

[Bridge]
Renew my mind, renew my heart
Make me new in every part
Renew my mind, renew my heart
Make me new in every part

[Outro]
Holy and pleasing to God
This is my spiritual worship
